category: 快門 / 動態殘影 (Shutter & Motion Blur)

entries.desc: 不指定快門速度或動態殘影，讓模型依場景自行決定是否有 motion blur。

entries.en: 1/1000s fast-shutter look, frozen movement, crisp subject edges, no motion blur, clean action stillness
entries.desc: 超高速快門語言，動作被定格，邊緣清楚，不帶可見殘影。

entries.en: 1/250s handheld shutter look, mostly sharp subject, minimal natural motion blur, stable everyday photographic clarity
entries.desc: 日常手持清晰快門，主體大多銳利，只保留極少自然動態模糊。
